analysis.title: 3Q26 call – all eyes on Meet the Management, 18–19 November
key_insights: ZKB rates Novartis Market Perform (previously Outperform until 13.08.2023). Share price CHF 127.48 on 26.10.2026.
3Q26 core EBIT margin was 41.6%, up 2 percentage points in local currency y/y, despite the Entresto patent expiry. For 9M26 the core EBIT margin is 40.1% (-0.8 percentage points in LC).
Novartis attributes the margin strength mainly to SG&A savings. Absolute SG&A fell by USD 356 mn (-3.6%) in 9M26 while USD revenue grew 2%.
Novartis expects both SG&A and COGS savings to be sustainable. ZKB says the medium-term guidance of a return to a core EBIT margin above 40% by GJ29 looks increasingly conservative.
Consensus core EBIT margins for GJ26-GJ29 are 38.7%, 39.3%, 39.7% and 40.6%. ZKB estimates are in the same range.
Novartis expects Entresto patent expiries outside the US and the Xolair expiry to weigh on the margin.

Growth driver performance is mixed. Cosentyx, Leqvio, Zolgensma and the new Rhapsido are performing well. Oncology products, particularly Pluvicto and also Kisqali and Scemblix, raise questions. ZKB expects no major change in momentum.

Meet the Management on 18/19 November in London: Novartis will extend its medium-term revenue growth targets by 1 year (previously 5-6% CAGR in LC for GJ25-30) and outline business performance in the first half of the 2030s.
Novartis currently guides to mid-single-digit revenue growth for the first half of the 2030s. How growth is distributed across individual years is not yet clear.
ZKB calls the event a very important milestone after pipeline setbacks and with patent expiries approaching for almost 40% of GJ29 revenue.

market_movers.rationale: ZKB keeps Novartis at Market Perform, citing a strong margin trend but open questions on growth in the early 2030s ahead of the 18-19 November Meet the Management event.
